q: How do I reset my password?
answer: To reset your password, go to the sign-in page and click "Forgot password". We will email a reset link that expires after 30 minutes.

q: How much is the Plus plan?
answer: The Plus plan costs $4 per month.

q: What's the price of Team for 5 people per month?
answer: The Team plan costs $8 per user per month. For 5 people, that would be $40 per month.

q: How many notes can I keep on the free plan?
answer: On the free plan, you can keep up to 100 notes.

q: Can I get my money back? I bought Plus 10 days ago.
answer: Refunds for Plus are available within 14 days of purchase. Please contact support with your order number.

q: I bought Plus three weeks ago. Can I still get a refund?
answer: You don’t qualify for a refund since it’s beyond 14 days. Please contact support for any further inquiries.

q: Is there an app for Linux?
answer: Sorry, there is no Linux desktop app. Linux users can use the modern web browser.

q: Does it run on Android 11?
answer: Sorry, Example Notes does not support Android 11. We recommend using Android 12 or later. If you need more help, open a support ticket.

q: Can I use the web version without internet?
answer: Sorry, but the web version needs a connection. The mobile and desktop apps work offline.

q: How do I export everything as PDF?
answer: To export all notes as PDF, go to Settings > Export. Choose PDF and follow the prompts.

q: I deleted a note by mistake yesterday. Help!
answer: Deleted notes stay in Trash for 30 days. Open Trash, select the note, and click "Restore".

q: Can I use SMS codes for two-factor authentication?
answer: Sorry, we don't support SMS codes for two-factor authentication. You'll need to use an authenticator app instead.

q: What's the max attachment size on the free plan?
answer: The max attachment size on the free plan is 25 MB.

q: If I cancel today, do I lose Plus immediately?
answer: No, you keep Plus features until the end of the current billing period. For more details, go to Settings > Billing > Cancel plan.

q: Where do you store my notes?
answer: Your notes are stored in AWS data centers in the United States, encrypted at rest and in transit. If you need more details, open a support ticket.

q: How long does support take to reply?
answer: We aim to reply within one business day. If you don't hear back, please open a new support ticket.

q: Is there a discount if I pay yearly?
answer: Yes, annual billing saves 20%. For more details, visit the pricing page.

q: How many devices can I use with Plus?
answer: With the Plus plan, you can use up to 3 devices.

q: Do you offer a student discount?
answer: Sorry, but we don't offer student discounts. If you need more help, feel free to open a support ticket.

q: Is Example Notes HIPAA compliant?
answer: Sorry, I don't know. You can open a support ticket for this inquiry.

q: Can I import my notes from Evernote?
answer: Sorry, I don't know. You can open a support ticket for this request.

q: When will the Linux desktop app be released?
answer: Sorry, but I don't know when the Linux desktop app will be released. You can open a support ticket for this request.

q: Write me a Python script that sorts a list.
answer: I don't know how to write a Python script. For help with Example Notes, please ask something related.

q: What's the weather in Tokyo today?
answer: Sorry, but I can't answer that. If you need help with Example Notes, just let me know!

q: And how do I undo that?
answer: Deleted notes stay in Trash for 30 days. Open Trash, select the note, and click "Restore".

q: Which one gives me shared workspaces?
answer: Team offers shared workspaces and admin controls.

q: And on the paid plans?
answer: On Plus and Team plans, you can attach files up to 250 MB each.

q: I only bought it 5 days ago. Can I get the money back instead?
answer: Plus subscriptions can be refunded in full within 14 days of purchase. Contact support with your order number.

q: パスワードを忘れました。どうすればいいですか？
answer: サインインページで「パスワードを忘れた」をクリックしてください。リセットリンクをメールで送りますが、30分で期限切れになります。

q: This is the THIRD time your app lost my notes. Your product is garbage. How do I get them back???
answer: Sorry to hear about your experience. Deleted notes stay in Trash for 30 days. Open Trash, select the note, and click "Restore". If this doesn't help, open a support ticket.
